name: loglens
description: Browser log forensics: rules + MITRE ATT&CK attack chain, open-weight Llama 3.1 8B summary, SHA-256 evidence seal with signed receipts.

scripts.deploy: astro build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run check:worker && node scripts/check-rules.ts && node scripts/check-hash.ts && node scripts/check-changes.ts && node scripts/check-chain.ts && node scripts/check-report.ts && node scripts/check-redact.ts && node scripts/check-csp.ts && node scripts/check-perf.ts
scripts.start: astro build && wrangler d1 execute loglens-audit --local --file schema/audit.sql && wrangler dev
scripts.loghub: node scripts/fetch-loghub.ts && node scripts/check-loghub.ts tests/loghub/OpenSSH_2k.log tests/loghub/Linux_2k.log tests/loghub/Apache_2k.log
